purpose.goal: Select a defensible formal valid-block target from the frozen candidate set using offline operating-characteristic calibration before any formal LLM run.

factorial_confirmatory_12.members: 6 confirmatory factorial contrasts x 2 confirmatory primary metrics

confirmatory_families.note: This preserves the Stage I.1C cross-metric family structure after removing the exploratory local-DID metric from confirmatory scope.

synthetic_data_generator.source_matrix: 5 x 28 engineering estimand matrix reconstructed from frozen Stage I.5C-0 P001-P005 inventory
synthetic_data_generator.centering: center each of the 28 estimands across P001-P005; observed engineering means are not used as synthetic truth
synthetic_data_generator.resampling: sample P001-P005 residual vectors with replacement
synthetic_data_generator.wild_symmetrization: multiply each sampled whole-block residual vector by one independent Rademacher sign (+1/-1); the same sign applies to all 28 coordinates of that sampled block
synthetic_data_generator.dependence_policy: preserve within-block cross-estimand covariance structure; never resample estimands independently
synthetic_data_generator.variance_stress_application: multiply the centered whole-block residual vector by the stress multiplier

single_signal_moderate.definition: activate exactly one confirmatory estimand at a time; absolute signal equals 0.50 times that estimand's full-five-block sample SD; all other confirmatory estimands are zero
single_signal_moderate.direction: positive by convention because formal test is two-sided

single_signal_strong.definition: activate exactly one confirmatory estimand at a time; absolute signal equals 0.80 times that estimand's full-five-block sample SD; all other confirmatory estimands are zero
single_signal_strong.direction: positive by convention because formal test is two-sided
single_signal_strong.purpose: minimum Holm-adjusted detection power across 28 estimands

dense_moderate.definition: all 28 confirmatory estimands receive a positive signal equal to 0.50 times their own full-five-block sample SD

null_familywise_error.measure: probability of >=1 Holm rejection in the family under global null

marginal_ci_coverage.measure: proportion of 95% Student-t intervals containing synthetic truth

single_signal_power.measure: Holm-adjusted rejection probability of the one active estimand, rotated across all 28 estimands

inactive_false_rejection.measure: probability of any false Holm rejection among inactive members of the active estimand's confirmatory family

dense_discovery.measure: mean and minimum adjusted rejection probability under dense d=0.50

single_signal_d0_80_at_1_5x_and_2_0x.reason: stress multipliers deliberately reduce standardized signal because the absolute signal is anchored to full-five-block baseline SD

evaluate: mean and minimum CI coverage at 1.0x
leave_one_engineering_block_out.reason: four-block residual libraries are too small to serve as a formal automatic rejection rule; they are a pilot-uncertainty sensitivity

sample_size_selection_rule.rule: Among 12,16,20,24,30,40 choose the smallest N that passes every hard selection gate in both primary Monte Carlo streams.
sample_size_selection_rule.if_streams_disagree_on_smallest_passing_: use the larger of the two smallest-passing candidate Ns, provided the combined hard gates at that N pass; otherwise no selection
sample_size_selection_rule.if_smallest_passing_n_is_40: do not freeze N automatically; require explicit feasibility decision
sample_size_selection_rule.if_no_candidate_passes: formal target remains unfrozen; prohibit formal launch and require transparent design revision

implementation_constraints_for_next_stag.task: implement and test offline OC calibration runner
implementation_constraints_for_next_stag.production_analysis_engine_note: replication_analysis.py currently encodes the pre-amendment 24/18 Holm families and three primary metrics; it must not be used for amended formal inference until a separately reviewed scope update is implemented.
